receiver.method: Adapted from the pinned PX4 TunerService under the recorded independent-code policy, after the backend type seam required by its candidate classification. Only the expressions listed under moved_scope are in the destinations; the original files remain GPL-2.0-only in the product, which keeps them as a facade over this engine.
authority: agent-workspace branch research/followup-extraction-candidates.json (classification needs_backend_type_seam for both source files)

source_files.moved_scope: Operation set of the backend seam at original lines 41-115 without default bodies; the nonce, lease/attachment ID, and time seams (118-144); the acquire result, attachment, stream counter, and final snapshot field sets (146-178); the disconnected terminal value (187); the stream-control operations attach, detach, stats, and final_snapshot (209-231); the TunerService public operations and private lease/state bookkeeping (256-363).
source_files.excluded_scope: The receiver_count and receiver_supports defaults with the fixed PX-Q3U4 layout (23-33), the default bodies of the power, disconnect, shutdown, and capture seams, the satellite-before-tune and terrestrial-settle defaults (37-40, 54-57), the remaining terminal values and read result (180-195), release_final, read, and terminal (232-253), and the ipc wire types. Receiver IDs became u16 identities separate from storage slots; frontend tune is one operation with an explicit kHz parameter; the settle decision became a backend-supplied duration.

source_files.moved_scope: The lifecycle algorithm at original lines 18-58 and 80-983: construction and shutdown on destruction, client and initial-system checks, lease lookup, lease and attachment ID allocation, acquire, release, lock polling, the tune sequence with power rollback and the post-lock settle arithmetic, stream start, attach with compensation, stop with final snapshot, stats, detach, both revoke forms, status, client cleanup, and shutdown.
source_files.excluded_scope: The px4_drv-referenced 340 ms terrestrial settle constant and its citation (11-14), which the product supplies through the backend seam; the PX4 wire request validation table valid_tune (59-78), whose per-request decision the product passes in the tune request; the fixed tune response payload construction (503-504).

r2_extension.method: New independent strict admission and deadline implementation layered over the recorded R1 lifecycle; the legacy direct tune path keeps its original post-power sequence, and no product source was copied for this extension.
r2_extension.scope: Internal opt-in strict capabilities, callback-free metadata admission, an end-to-end tune budget measured from admission, cancellation-safe tickets, and token-free operation/tune metadata. No public v1 wire record, token exposure, product facade cutover, or backend change.
r2_extension.new_files: tests/receiver_r2_tests.cpp is independently written and carries MIT.

exact_hz_extension.method: New internal engine entrance and backend seam, adapting the accepted Hz request contract to the existing strict admission, pending ticket, tune stages and final publication. No product source or arithmetic was copied.
authority: design/adoption-status.md, frequency and hardware capability qualifications
exact_hz_extension.scope: Exact u64 requested Hz is passed to an opt-in backend callback and retained with optional backend-reported programmed Hz. Legacy direct and strict kHz entrances retain the existing kHz callback. No rounding, common upper bound, channel formula, product adapter, capture, control-client, CLI, or wire connection is introduced.
exact_hz_extension.new_files: tests/receiver_hz_tests.cpp is independently written and carries MIT.

identity.method: The selector, instance, USB descriptor and auto-identity codecs are a new independent implementation of the adopted byte representation. The only mechanical transfer is the neutral SHA-256 class, extracted under the standing independent-code policy; no selector/discovery/hardware source was copied.
authority: agent-workspace branch design/adoption-status.md, design/device-selection-proposal.md and design/runtime-command-draft.md

source_files.moved_scope: Only the `class Sha256 final { ... };` body at original lines 28-171. The identical class body also appears in ASICEN fixed 76299585 userland/src/sha256.h lines 18-161; both calculate to class-body sha256 4117bc2b38ac968a5b1519a3e30fc5224aa94f15ddfb02a8b38d34590a35279b (no trailing newline), re-checked equal to the copied destination class body.
source_files.excluded_scope: The file header comments, include guard, namespace, firmware policy, file reads, IT930x operations, firmware constants and product types. Class dependencies are only array/cstddef/cstdint.

identity.new_files: include/dtv/userland/identity.h, src/identity.cpp, include/dtv/userland/detail/text.h, tests/identity_tests.cpp and tests/consumer/identity/ are independently written under the standing policy and carry MIT.

wire.method: New independent implementation of the documented common UDTV wire; no PX4 wire source was copied or modified.
wire.scope: UDTV 1.0 envelope and bounded frame/header handling; typed HELLO request, HELLO response, error response, ACQUIRE request/response, LIST/STATUS snapshots (producer, context, topology, enclosure, USB functions, receiver/reader descriptors and status, measurements and counters), TUNE request/result, START/ATTACH/STOP/RELEASE, TS_DATA, STATE_EVENT/STREAM_END and the CARD_*/transaction records, all with bounded storage, control-payload cap preflight and cross-record validators. It is not a complete protocol: dispatcher/connection state, timers, sockets, JSON/CLI translation and product endpoint migration are out of scope.
wire.error_values_added: RESOURCE_LIMIT = 17 was added additively for the control-payload cap. All pre-existing Error values and the one-byte size are unchanged.
wire.provenance: Independently written from design/common-wire-draft.md, wire-record-layout.md, common-api-contract.md, json-record-contract.md and cli-contract-draft.md under the conditional adoption in design/adoption-status.md and the scope in design/independent-code-policy.md. The STATUS enclosure optional booleans follow the accepted internal layout from Core development commits a9c72e75a66c66c274c6df3804a14510d3ba44c0 and 303840acabf84c0d4d87c3158bd0adca19e90d76; only the typed fields and their STATUS codec order are included in this increment. LNB operation, host_ctl, JSON and product backend changes are excluded. No product payload, card/hardware sequence or vendor asset was copied.

tuning.method: New independent bounded resolver implementation from the adopted CLI contract and the T1 implementation specification; no product parser or product source was copied.
authority: shared/design/adoption-status.md, selection meaning and frequency contract
tuning.scope: Pure C++17 channel/typed-Hz/system/selection resolution using the existing wire System and Selection enums. No CLI option parser, repeated-option policy, wire request construction, backend capability checks, hardware quantization, product endpoint, or C ABI.
tuning.new_files: include/dtv/userland/tuning.h, src/tuning.cpp, tests/tuning_tests.cpp, tests/consumer/tuning/, tests/consumer/missing_receiver/ and docs/tuning.md are independently written and carry MIT.

card_ownership.method: Adapted from the isolated PX4 card ownership implementation under the recorded independent-code policy. AtrSnapshot is an opaque template value; product CardAtr, NativeCardProtocolSession, IPC enums, and the APDU compatibility limit remain in the GPL facade.

source_files.moved_scope: The protocol session operation set at original lines 14-25, backend operations and result/presence value fields at 47-71, and ownership operations/state declarations at 73-157, adapted to neutral card-share/disposition enums, byte spans, and CardOwnershipSession/Backend seams.
source_files.excluded_scope: NativeCardProtocolSession and CardSession binding at original lines 27-43; Q3U4/device-specific backend policy in the comment at 45-46; PX4 IPC types; product CardAtr definition and hardware session implementation.

source_files.moved_scope: The ownership, sharing, presence/generation, session, transaction, disconnect, cleanup, and error-order algorithm at original lines 10-551. The source's ipc::kMaxCardPayload check at 461-464 is parameterized by the facade constructor at the same validation position.
source_files.excluded_scope: The Q3U4Runtime/SPEC product-specific comment at original lines 31-33, PX4 IPC enum and header dependencies, and all CardAtr/Native protocol/hardware interpretation. Snapshot values remain opaque and are only defaulted, copied, or returned.

json.method: New independent bounded STATUS JSON projection. The previous Core #13 implementation was consulted for size counting, JSON escaping and validation-before-write properties only; its public field map and fixture were not adopted.
authority: agent-workspace DECISIONS-20261021.md, STATUS public JSON approval
RC-INTEGRATION-CHECKPOINT-20261019.md, adopted JSON types and meanings
Core main StatusResponse layout after PR #29
json.scope: Pure C++17 StatusResponse-to-JSON size and encoding functions with canonical-context validation, byte-count preflight, bounded output and no allocation. No CLI, daemon, discovery scan aggregation, product backend, product pin or wire layout changes.
json.new_files: include/dtv/userland/json.h, src/json.cpp, tests/status_json_tests.cpp, tests/status_json_consumer.py, tests/consumer/json/, and docs/json-status.md are independently written and carry MIT.

discovery_json.method: New bounded full-scan discovery JSON projection. The STATUS JSON implementation in the parent commit was consulted only for local writer conventions; it was not modified and its record projection is not reused as scan input.
authority: RC-INTEGRATION-CHECKPOINT-20261019.md, accepted discovery hierarchy, fields and serial uniqueness meaning
discovery_json.scope: A scan envelope containing observed enclosures, scan completeness/issues and grouped or ungrouped USB observations with nullable location/serial data. Projects physical enclosure/device/reader/receiver hierarchy, static LNB capability, enclosure grouping status and duplicate candidates, systems, STATUS-aligned enclosure/USB function id keys, VID:PID strings and scan-local serial uniqueness. It validates receiver-number uniqueness across each enclosure and does not adapt one ListResponse into a full scan or add STATUS dynamic state.
discovery_json.new_files: include/dtv/userland/discovery_json.h, src/discovery_json.cpp, tests/discovery_json_tests.cpp, tests/discovery_json_consumer.py, tests/consumer/discovery_json/, and docs/json-discovery.md are independently written and carry MIT.
